title: T006 focus and T008 safety order with complexity-compliant structural helpers (Draft)

why5.question: Why is T006 still BLOCKED after BS-P1-025 Activation?
why5.answer: PR #372 activated T008 as the sole IN_PROGRESS task although the Human's goal was T006 closure. T001-T005, T006's dependencies, are all CLOSED; T008 is not among T006 blocked_by dependencies.

why5.question: Why cannot task focus be changed by existing safe control transition?
why5.answer: T008's F01/F07 four revalidations remain IN_PROGRESS; existing backlog validator disallows a BLOCKED owning Task, and change-scope disallows bundling validator change with control files. Faking VERIFIED/CLOSED would falsify missing evidence.

why5.question: How is revalidation history preserved?
why5.answer: Do not modify delivery/backlog/QUEUE.json at all. Leave T008's four revalidation claims and prior T007 CLOSED historical record exactly unchanged. Change only T008 status IN_PROGRESS -> BLOCKED (not CLOSED) and T006 BLOCKED -> IN_PROGRESS, plus active_task to T006.

why5.question: Why does this not authorize unrelated governance or product changes?
why5.answer: Exact six-path T006 focus change against fixed main, with helper-level fail-closed checks for unchanged product and CLOSED Task history. Three validator functions were split into simpler helpers to satisfy ESLint complexity without broadening permissions, after earlier Human-approved candidate failed lint. why5.question: What is the condition for closing T006?
why5.answer: T006 must first satisfy nine product Acceptance/Test IDs, real S03 E2E and independent Evidence/Review, then become VERIFIED. T008 becomes the sole active Task under a later separately approved legal control transition and must pass four new BS025 security proofs plus independent Closure. An exact REVIEW state with T006 VERIFIED and T008 CLOSED allows sequential Human T006 Closure rather than illegal Task regression or same-commit closure. Final T006 CLOSED and Sprint closure are separate approved control operations. Neither this PR nor the synthetic checks grant execution or Human approval.
